commit: feat(lib)!: use package name for css output file name

truth.description: buildHtmlPlugin now reads cssBundleNameCache with this.environment.config, but cssPostPlugin stores the bundle name under the top-level config and PartialEnvironment builds environment.config as a new Proxy that is never a key of that cache, so cssBundleName is always undefined and an app built with build.cssCodeSplit false no longer gets its stylesheet link injected into index.html.

distractions.why: Lightning CSS reads this filename only to label its warnings and errors, so the default name is harmless when the bundle is named after the package.
